name: Core Usage Report
intro_text: List each project that used your core this period. Use one row per project. In the case where a lab has multiple projects that use your core, that lab can appear more than once. We’ll put your rows into NIH’s suggested Table 2 (Core Users) for the Center’s yearly report, so you don’t need to fill in the table yourself.

about: Your list shows NIH who uses your core and what came of it.
One row per project. Count students in their own column.

users.label: Read NIH’s directions for Table 2 (NIGMS suggested RPPR tables, PDF, opens in a new tab)

_source: RPPR Table 2 'COBRE Core Users', FY27 COBRE Reporting Guidance p.10 (MW, 2026-10-26, item 7a). One table per core except the Admin Core. Intro shortened 2026-10-28 (MW approved); original: "List each project that used your core during this reporting period. Use one row per project. A lab may be listed more than once if different projects were supported. The Center combines these lists into its yearly NIH progress report." MW 2026-11-02: matched NIGMS's suggested Table 2: no 'Students' user type; individual users include students.

sections.title: Projects that used the core this period
sections.instructions: Count everyone who worked on the project with the core as an individual user, students included. Then give how many of them were students.
